purpose: Durable path-free summary of Keyspilli evidence experiments

entries.purpose: Reduce metal rhythm-wall contamination and source handoffs while preserving vocals and lead detail
entries.route: Demucs/Basic Pitch stems -> source-aware metal arrangement -> learner variants
entries.result: Structural cleanup passed, but residual contour and AMT evidence did not support recognizability.
entries.decision: Keep bounded source-aware cleanup; do not claim musical success.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: delete generated stems/renders after conclusions are recorded

entries.purpose: Collapse guitar harmonic detector stacks into semantic attacks and route rhythm roots to LH
entries.route: source-locked guitar selector -> harmonic clusters -> root/quality stabilization -> chord/LH construction
entries.result: Synthetic harmonic, jitter, root-stability, source-lock, and variant gates passed; real-song listening remained poor.
entries.decision: Preserve implementation and diagnostics; defer further contour research.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: retain summaries only; generated raw outputs are ephemeral

entries.purpose: Compare a private human MIDI reference to generated Defence of Moscow structure
entries.route: private reference MIDI -> local feature/alignment diagnostics only
entries.result: Human reference sounded good; generated direct-metal output was not recognizable. Candidate/reference timing was not silently warped.
entries.decision: Keep references private and evaluation-only; require explicit aligned windows.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: private source retained; no repository copy

entries.purpose: Test Audiveris/HOMR and canonical-spine score extraction as a symbolic alternative
entries.route: private score/PDF -> Audiveris/HOMR -> MusicXML/MIDI -> role/alignment diagnostics
entries.result: Useful engineering diagnostics, insufficient stable coverage/alignment for generation.
entries.decision: Deprioritize OMR as production authority; retain optional local adapter.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: retain compact manifests/reports, delete raster/intermediate output

entries.purpose: Measure raw stem evidence against human references before blaming learner simplification
entries.route: Demucs/Basic Pitch and alternate AMT stems -> raw/decoded/current Easy oracle
entries.result: Timing evidence exists, but pitch fidelity and downstream retention are weak; raw evidence is the limiting oracle.
entries.decision: Do not broaden arranger thresholds without a new evidence source.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: delete WAV/stems after hashes are recorded

entries.purpose: Freeze provenance and alignment status for seven private benchmark songs
entries.route: provider-neutral metadata and permitted local symbolic inputs; benchmark bytes evaluation-only
entries.result: Submitted-local references are musically useful but do not establish independent acquisition or aligned generation evidence.
entries.decision: Keep EXTERNAL_SYMBOLIC_FIRST fail-closed until a candidate has independent alignment.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: retain private originals; delete duplicate downloaded/derived bundles

entries.purpose: Back up local history, preserve conclusions, and reclaim ephemeral experiment storage
entries.route: Git/secret audit -> path-free ledgers -> remote branch/tag -> classified cleanup
entries.result: No protected binaries or credentials found in unpublished history; cleanup is limited to verified generated outputs.
entries.decision: Push topic history and checkpoint tag; retain private sources and unknown/active data.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: see storage-inventory.json and ignored local retention manifest

entries.purpose: Assess whether a bounded open-data symbolic shadow corpus can prove EXTERNAL_SYMBOLIC_FIRST
entries.route: synthetic aligned shadow fixtures; bounded BabySlakh acquisition attempt kept separate from benchmark data
entries.result: The full route is deterministic on synthetic aligned data; the official archive was only partially acquired and was not consumed.
entries.decision: Do not claim a real open-data corpus result or retain the invalid partial archive.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: retain compact synthetic reports only; remove invalid partial media after handle check

entries.purpose: Calibrate symbolic alignment against hidden deterministic corruptions
entries.route: aligned synthetic symbolic input -> offset/tempo/transpose/section corruption -> symbolic aligner
entries.result: Global transforms recovered exactly; section edits are partial/diagnostic and the 32-bar gate is not classifiable from eight-bar fixtures.
entries.decision: Keep the existing three-window/32-bar gate and report independent-evidence insufficiency.

entries.purpose: Measure whether the direct-piano route damages trusted symbolic material
entries.result: Advanced and Medium preserve the tested material; Easy simplifies materially but remains structurally coherent in the bounded fixtures.
entries.decision: No generic direct-piano arranger change in this mission.

entries.purpose: Recheck legitimate external symbolic, piano-cover, and structured-harmony evidence for all seven cold songs
entries.route: provider retrieval and metadata audit; HTML/auth/paywall responses fail closed
entries.result: Piano-cover and structured-harmony aids exist, but no symbolic bytes with independent target-recording alignment were acquired.
entries.decision: Keep all seven out of generation and human-readiness gates.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: retain compact research report; no downloaded media

entries.purpose: Close the raw-to-difficulty provenance gap with an optional development trace
entries.result: The optional trace links retained difficulty events to canonical final keys and exposes the first downstream loss for a cold Red Baron run; public MIDI/API shapes remain unchanged.
entries.decision: Keep tracing diagnostics-only; do not tune the decoder from the cold reference.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: retain compact reports and path-free trace only while diagnosing; no reference bytes staged

entries.purpose: Separate raw pitch/onset support from decoder and learner contour loss
entries.route: cold raw guitar oracle -> source-aware lead/semantic/canonical/Easy diagnostics
entries.result: Timing evidence is present, but pitch support is weak and downstream loss is large; no generic threshold change is justified.
entries.decision: Defer richer source-aware learner contour work until a trustworthy symbolic generation candidate exists.

entries.purpose: Determine whether a cold-song A/B listening pack is justified
entries.route: independent symbolic alignment -> three windows/32 bars -> human readiness
entries.result: No cold song satisfies the independent evidence and alignment gate; existing controlled audio remains pre-gate.
entries.decision: Do not generate or publish a listening pack; await a qualifying external candidate and human review.

entries.purpose: Separate upstream pitch availability from pre-decoder filtering and selector loss on cold guitar stems
entries.route: raw guitar oracle -> source-filtered selector -> lead diagnostics
entries.result: The raw ceiling retains timing evidence but weak exact pitch; pre-selector role/rhythm filters dominate raw-to-selector loss while the candidate cap removes none in the audited runs.
entries.decision: Do not broaden noisy candidates or tune a global score; pursue a richer source-aware decoder only as a separate experiment.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: retain compact metrics and delete duplicate generated media

entries.purpose: Make semantic harmony and stage-reference diagnostics traceable without changing public MIDI/API payloads
entries.route: validated raw -> lead/residual/semantic/chord/LH/final trace; post-generation reference-support evaluator
entries.result: Invalid source events are excluded before tracing, routed rhythm/fallback harmony retain raw ancestry, and reference-support labels are attached only to the evaluator report; harmonic fifth diagnostics no longer count legitimate triad fifths as duplicates.
entries.decision: Keep lineage and support accounting diagnostics-only; do not feed reference labels into generation or claim musical recognizability.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: retain compact path-free reports only; reference media remains outside the repository

entries.purpose: Run the single pre-registered isolated Guitar-TECHS A/B tie-breaker for a guitar-specific AMT backend
entries.route: frozen Guitar-TECHS v1 (14 items, DI and amp/mic) -> pinned GAPS guitar AMT -> shared upstream evaluator against frozen Basic Pitch
entries.result: GAPS materially improved onset, exact-pitch, and pitch-class F1 on both isolated modalities, increased exact precision while reducing note-count overproduction, and cleared five nontrivial technique families on both modalities; pinch-harmonics regressed.
entries.rawArtifactRetention: retain compact path-free report, pre-registration, run manifest, and hashes only; delete reacquirable benchmark audio, checkpoint, environment, and feature/cache material
